title: Full quadratic prefix value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $w$ be a Boolean sequence of length $n$. The quadratic value of the prefix of length $n$ equals the quadratic value of the vector obtained by mapping every Boolean coordinate of $w$ into $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean sequence indexed by $0,\ldots,n-1$
